questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
The work done in stopping the car and the truck can be written as

$\begin{cases}W & = & Fx \\ & = & ∆ KE\end{cases}$

As both the car and the truck are moving initially with the same kinetic energy, after being stopped, they will have the same change of kinetic energy.

Also, they are stopped with the same applied force.

Hence, from the above equation, it can be written that~they have the same displacement, i.e.,~${x}_{1} = {x}_{2}$.

Acceleration is a vector quantity. As the direction of motion of the car is different in the two given situations, the acceleration of the car will not be the same.

questions.q: The effect of lanthanoid contraction in the lanthanoid series of elements by and large means

questions.q: Which of the following has least tendency to liberate ${H}_{2}$ from mineral acids?
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Element $\left(M\right)$ $E^{⊝} / V$
$Mn$ $- 1 . 18$
$Ni$ $- 0 . 25$
$Cu$ $0 . 34$
$Zn$ $- 0 . 76$

As we can see that Copper is least electropositive metal among the given options. So, it does not react with dilute sulphuric acid or other mineral acids, liberating hydrogen because copper is lower in electrochemical series than hydrogen. All other metals will react with mineral acids to liberate hydrogen gas.

questions.q: The lanthanide ion that would show colour is:
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
The elements or ions having unpaired electrons show colour. The valence shell electronic configuration of& ${La}^{3 +}$~and~${Lu}^{3 +}$~are~$4f^{0}\text{and}4f^{14}$~respectively. Hence, they are colourless.~${Gd}^{3 +}$~is also colourless,~this is because, here $4f$~orbitals are half filled,hence stable.As such $f - f$ transitions are not possible because they will destroy the symmetry of $4f$~and make them unstable.~${Sm}^{3 +}$~has the valence shell electronic configuration~$4f^{5}$, hence, it is coloured due to the presence of unpaired electrons.

$La^{+ 3} =$ Colourless
$Gd^{+ 3} =$ Colourless
$Sm^{+ 3} =$ Pale yellow colour
$Lu^{+ 3} =$ Colourless

questions.q:
For the following Assertion and Reason, the correct option is:
Assertion: For hydrogenation reactions, the catalytic activity increases from Group $5$ to Group $11$ metals with maximum activity shown by Group $7 - 9$ elements.
Reason: The reactants are most strongly adsorbed on group $7 - 9$ elements.
options: The assertion is true, but the reason is false
Both assertion and reason are false
Both assertion and reason are true and the reason is the correct explanation for the assertion
Both assertion and reason are true but the reason is not the correct explanation for the assertion
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution: The general trend for the activity for hydrogenation increases from left to right. In Hydrogenation reaction, catalytic activity depends on variable oxidation states as well as atomic size. Hence for hydrogenation reactions, the catalytic activity increases from a group 5 to group 11 metals with maximum activity shown by group 7-9 elements.

questions.q: The number of electrons involved in the reduction of permanganate to manganese dioxide in acidic medium is _____ .
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Permanganate is reduced to Manganese dioxide by the following reaction:
$\overset{+ 7}{MnO4 -} + 4H^{+} + 3e^{-} ⟶ \overset{+ 4}{Mn}{O}_{2} + 2{H}_{2}O$
Here, oxidation no. of manganese was reduced by 3 from reactant to product side. Thus, three electrons are involved.

questions.q: Among ${Co}^{3 +}, {Ti}^{2 +}, V^{2 +}$ and ${Cr}^{2 +}$ ions, one if used as a reagent cannot liberate ${H}_{2}$ from dilute mineral acid solution, its spin-only magnetic moment in gaseous state is _____& B.M. (Nearest integer)

questions.solution:
Among the given species& ${Co}^{3 +}$~cannot undergo oxidation, hence,~${Co}^{3 +}$ can't liberate ${H}_{2}$.

It has $d^{6}$~configuration,

Number of unpaired electrons $= 4$

$\mu = \sqrt{n\left(n + 2\right)}B . M\mu = \sqrt{4 \times 6} = 4 . 92B . M .$
